passage.text: Emma shows Nam a screenshot on her phone.
passage.reading: ˈɛmə ˈʃoʊz ˈnɑːm ə ˈskriːnʃɑːt ɑːn hɜːr ˈfoʊn.

passage.text: "Look at this!" she says. "All universities in Bangkok will close next week. The air is too dangerous."
passage.reading: ˈlʊk ət ˈðɪs! ʃiː ˈsɛz. ˈɔːl ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsətiz ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk wɪl ˈkloʊz ˈnɛkst ˈwiːk. ði ˈɛr ɪz ˈtuː ˈdeɪndʒərəs.

passage.text: "Where did you get it?" Nam asks.
passage.reading: ˈwɛr dɪd juː ˈɡɛt ɪt? ˈnɑːm ˈæsks.

passage.text: "A friend sent it to me," Emma says. "Everyone is sharing it."
passage.reading: ə ˈfrɛnd ˈsɛnt ɪt tə miː, ˈɛmə ˈsɛz. ˈɛvriwʌn ɪz ˈʃɛrɪŋ ɪt.

passage.text: Nam looks at the screenshot carefully.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ˈlʊks ət ðə ˈskriːnʃɑːt ˈkɛrfəli.

passage.text: "I have my doubts," she says. "There's no date, and I don't know this website."
passage.reading: aɪ ˈhæv maɪ ˈdaʊts, ʃiː ˈsɛz. ðɛrz ˈnoʊ ˈdeɪt, ənd aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈnoʊ ˈðɪs ˈwɛbsaɪt.

passage.text: "I don't think so. Anyone can make a screenshot like this," Nam says.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈθɪŋk ˈsoʊ. ˈɛniwʌn kən ˈmeɪk ə ˈskriːnʃɑːt laɪk ˈðɪs, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛz.

passage.text: They check the university's website, but there is nothing about it.
passage.reading: ðeɪ ˈtʃɛk ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsətiz ˈwɛbsaɪt, bʌt ðɛr ɪz ˈnʌθɪŋ əˈbaʊt ɪt.

passage.text: Then they look at two big news websites.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn ðeɪ ˈlʊk ət ˈtuː ˈbɪɡ ˈnuːz ˈwɛbsaɪts.

passage.text: Neither of them says that the universities will close.
passage.reading: ˈniːðər əv ðɛm ˈsɛz ðæt ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsətiz wɪl ˈkloʊz.

passage.text: "So it isn't a fact. It's just a rumor," Nam says.
passage.reading: soʊ ɪt ˈɪzənt ə ˈfækt. ɪts ˈdʒʌst ə ˈruːmər, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "You're right," says Emma. "From now on, I'll check the facts before I share anything."
passage.reading: jʊr ˈraɪt, ˈsɛz ˈɛmə. frəm ˈnaʊ ˈɑːn, aɪl ˈtʃɛk ðə ˈfækts bɪˈfɔːr aɪ ˈʃɛr ˈɛniθɪŋ.

passage.text: "Good idea," Nam says. "Let's tell your friend, too."
passage.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛz. ˈlɛts ˈtɛl jʊr ˈfrɛnd, ˈtuː.
